title: Capability Audit: 87 Unmapped
markdown:
# Capability Audit Report

**Audit Date:** 2026-04-19
**Status:** 87 Unmapped Capabilities

## Summary

The capability map refresh detected 87 live capabilities without formal schema definitions in the capability registry. These are fully functional but undocumented in the capability map system.

## Breakdown

### Skills (27 unmapped)
- autonomous, build, ci-fix, coherence-audit, commit-action, crossreview, degradation-digest
- docs-code-sync, evolve, feedback, fork-and-fix, gaps, git-sync, guardian-pulse
- instar-dev, learn, memory-hygiene, reflect, rollback-from-artifact, session-continuity-check
- spec-converge, specreview, state-integrity-check, threadline-sync, triage-findings

### Jobs (22 unmapped)
- capability-audit, ci-monitor, coherence-audit, commitment-detection
- dashboard-link-refresh, degradation-digest, docs-code-sync, evolution-overdue-check
- evolution-proposal-evaluate, evolution-proposal-implement, feedback-retry, git-sync
- github-collab-monitor, guardian-pulse, health-check, insight-harvest, memory-export
- memory-hygiene, overseer-development, overseer-guardian, overseer-infrastructure
- overseer-learning, overseer-maintenance, project-map-refresh, reflection-trigger
- relationship-maintenance, session-continuity-check, state-integrity-check, threadline-sync

### Scripts (11 unmapped)
- git-sync-gate.sh, github-monitor-scan.sh, health-watchdog.sh, imessage-reply.sh
- post-update.sh, slack-reply.sh, smart-fetch.py, telegram-reply.sh, test-coverage-reminder.js

### Context Files (11 unmapped)
- DISPATCH.md, architecture.md, communication.md, deployment.md, development.md
- identity.md, project.md, relationships.md, research-navigation.md, safety.md, session.md

### Subsystems (12 unmapped)
- auto-updates, evolution, feedback, monitoring, playbook, publishing, relationships
- scheduler, session-manager, state-manager, telegram, topic-memory, tunnel

## Impact

**Low operational risk** — All capabilities run normally. The capability map is a self-documentation and discoverability system; missing schemas don't break functionality.

**High documentation gap** — New capabilities added to instar lack formal definitions. This prevents:
- Automatic capability discovery (`GET /capabilities`)
- Schema-driven validation
- Capability-dependent routing and gating
- Self-documenting capability inventory

## Recommendation

Populate capability map schemas incrementally as new capabilities are built. This audit will auto-repeat weekly to track drift.
